model_output.verdict: A logistics and maintenance leader with measurable results and a clear move toward operations supervision.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for operations supervision! At Fort Cavazos, you led maintenance, supply and fuel sections, managed equipment accountability and improved vehicle readiness. A recruiter can see both the people you led and what changed under your leadership.

The vehicle readiness line is the model: it gives the starting rate, the ending rate and the changes you made to get there. Your progression through Army maintenance roles is easy to follow, and your supervisor target is clear at the top.

Let's make the field exercise line more concrete, then bring the readiness result higher in the Platoon Sergeant role. Your resume is unlikely to be the thing holding you back on its own; the competitiveness of each civilian role will also matter.
